create_diagnostic_tool: create a subclass of DiagnosticToolBaseClass that implements create_document to visualize MonteCarloSamples
show_diagnostic_tool: show the diagnostic tool in a Jupyter notebook by calling the show method on a DiagnosticToolBaseClass instance
load_tool_js: load the JavaScript bundle for a diagnostic tool from the yarn-built distribution directory
html_template_css: get the HTML template with CSS styles for Bokeh loading overlays on diagnostic tools
debug_tool_json: debug a diagnostic tool by calling _tool_json to get a JSON-serializable Bokeh document representation
